name: Brunei
description: Brunei from a sultanate that once ruled much of Borneo to British protection, oil, independence in 1984 and one of the world's longest reigns.

checkpoints.name: The sultanate
checkpoints.note: Brunei became a Muslim sultanate and in the 1500s ruled much of Borneo, before losing land to Sarawak and North Borneo.

checkpoints.name: British protection
checkpoints.note: Brunei became a British protectorate in 1888. Oil was struck at Seria in 1929, and a revolt in 1962 was put down.

checkpoints.name: Independent Brunei
checkpoints.note: Brunei became independent in 1984 and lives from oil and gas under Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah.
